description.default: Client script: shows the five usage metrics (RPD / TPD / RPM / ITPM / OTPM) as freely draggable pills, centered below the top bar by default. Each pill can be shown or hidden individually, and the gauge button in the host top bar opens a menu with per-pill toggles, show / hide all, range switching, layout reset and refresh now. Refresh interval and glow duration are picked with level sliders (refresh 1 / 2 / 5 / 10 / 30 / 60s; glow 3 / 5 / 8 / 12s or continuous). Pill width adapts to its content, so long numbers are neither clipped nor overlapping. Reads the local usage metadata domain only - no network, no API profile list.
description.zh-CN: 客户端脚本：把 RPD / TPD / RPM / ITPM / OTPM 五项用量指标显示成可自由拖放的胶囊，默认居中在顶栏下方。每颗可单独显示或隐藏；顶栏仪表按钮打开菜单，可逐颗开关、全部显示 / 隐藏、切换统计范围、重置位置与立即刷新。刷新速度与光效时长用档位滑块选择（刷新 1/2/5/10/30/60 秒，光效 3/5/8/12 秒或「持续不停」）。胶囊宽度随内容自适应，长数字不裁字也不叠字。只读本机 usage 元数据域，不联网、不读 API 档案列表。
